newsitem.title: FRANCE: Essilor slips on sales figure.
newsitem.headline: Essilor slips on sales figure.

text.p: Shares in Essilor slipped slightly on Tuesday after the company published sales figures which were a bit below market expectations, especially for the last quarter, dealers and analysts said.
At 1202 GMT, it was down 0.85 percent at 1,627 francs while the SBF-120 index was 0.37 percent lower.
Essilor had announced a 19.7 percent rise in 1996 sales fo 7.8 billion francs, or a 5.4 percent rise on a like-for-like basis.
"We had been expecting a rise of six percent, excluding the U.S. laboratories. The fourth quarter is a bit less good as we expected and not as good as the third quarter," said an analyst.
Another analyst said the market reaction was limited. Essilor shares gained 65 percent in 1995 and has advanced another 3.3 percent since the start of the year.
